[edit]
user@host# show applications
    application src_2123 {
        application-protocol gprs-gtp-c;
        protocol udp;
        source-port 2123;
        destination-port 0-0;
    }
    application src_3386 {
        application-protocol gprs-gtp-v0;
        protocol udp;
        source-port 3386;
        destination-port 0-0;
    }
